summary: Copilot is spread across settings pages, a sidebar config, per-app settings and edge://flags. There is no single switch, and users report it reappearing after updates.

steps.path: edge://settings/appearance/copilotAndSidebar → turn off Copilot in the sidebar, then check the Copilot section under "App-specific settings"
Open edge://flags, search "AI" and "Copilot", disable at least: Enable Compose (AI writing) on the web, Edge Copilot Mode, Edge History AI
Managed devices: use the Edge policies (HubsSidebarEnabled, CopilotCDPPageContext, etc.) rather than flags.

collateral: some Copilot entry points return after major Edge releases
whyTheyDidIt: Edge is Microsoft's main distribution channel for Copilot on the desktop.

sources.label: Kaspersky — how to disable AI features in Microsoft apps

alternatives.name: Firefox
alternatives.why: one toggle blocks all AI enhancements
